info.syllabusName: Kiểm tra và Đánh giá trong giảng dạy ngoại ngữ (Testing and Assessment in Foreign Language Teaching)
info.syllabusEnglish: Testing and Assessment in Foreign Language Teaching
info.description:
This course consists of 12 chapters and is divided into 2 parts.

Part 1: Chapter 1 to chapter 6 present kinds of tests, kinds of testing and assessment; characteristics of a good test, how to compose a good test.

Part 2: Chapter 7 to chapter 12 present how to test vocabulary, pronunciation, grammar , reading, listening, writing and speaking
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails:
- Know the basic principles and procedures for developing and evaluating tests.
- Understand the differences between testing and assessment, kinds of test and testing.

- Analyze characteristics of a good test and how to get beneficial backwash;
- Analyze the features of test techniques.
- Use appropriate techniques to design tests and assessment to test vocabulary, grammar and reading, speaking, listening and writing skills.

- Understand the connection between testing, assessment, and language teaching and learning.
- Understand the importance of testing and evaluation in teaching and learning languages.
